name: zuma
title: Zuma — zk Yuma consensus
description: Zuma = zk Yuma consensus. Miners and validators prove they are IN the set with ring signatures, never WHICH member, so nobody can collude with a known counterparty; weights stay sealed (commit-reveal) and Yuma clips outliers to the stake-weighted median.

everyone_sees: the two member sets (public keys and stake)
tags, nullifiers and sealed weights for each round
kept_secret: which miner is behind which tag
weights until every validator has locked in
a member across rounds: tags and nullifiers change every round
privacy.summary: Members prove they belong without saying who they are (ring signatures).
